analysis:
XERS surged 25.2%, 29.6 percentage points above the market's 4.4% decline, following its Q3 earnings report released today. The coverage reports that results topped estimates, with headlines indicating a 125% earnings surprise and the CEO projecting Recorlev (a key product) reaching $1 billion in annual sales 3-4 years earlier than expected, potentially pushing the stock to seven-year highs.

The stock's earnings history shows substantial volatility around reports, with a typical abnormal move of 13.2 percentage points beyond what the market explains. However, the pattern between beating estimates and stock direction has been inconsistent: of the four prior beats in the data, one was followed by a negative abnormal move. Today's 27.0-point abnormal move ranks as the second-largest in the recent history, behind only August 2025's 20.3-point gain on a beat. Estimates had been trending down over recent months, with all revisions in the past 30 days negative.
